errors.text_span: и без единици, тъй като стойностите са изразени в проценти
errors.evidence: The description states that the Y-axis has no units, which is incorrect. The axis labels clearly show the percent sign (%), indicating that the unit is percentage.

The word 'сплошна' is used six times to describe the lines. This is not a standard Bulgarian word for 'solid' in this context; the correct word would be 'плътна'. This linguistic error reduces clarity.

errors.text_span: леко се повишава до 10–11% през 2010–2012 г.
errors.evidence: For Алианц Банк България (orange line), the description states it rises to 10-11%. The graph shows the line stays consistently below 10% for the entire period.
For Ти Би Ай Банк (dark gray line), the description claims it drops to ~12% in 2013. The graph shows the value in 2013 is approximately 17%. The drop to ~12% happens in 2014.
For ПроКредит Банк (yellow line), the description states it drops to ~10% in 2015. In the graph, the value for 2015 is approximately 12.5%.

The description of БАКБ (light blue line) omits the initial trend. The line starts at ~23%, rises to a peak of ~26% in 2010-2011, and only then begins to fall. The description incorrectly starts with the falling trend.

errors.text_span: спада до около 18% през 2013 г., след това се възстановява до около 20% през 2016 г. и остава между 16% и 20% до 2027 г.
errors.evidence: This entire sequence for БАКБ (light blue line) is incorrect. In 2013, the value is ~21%, not 18%. The line does not recover to 20% in 2016; it actually falls to about 15.5%. From 2018 onwards, it stabilizes around 16%, not in a wide 16-20% range.
For Токуда (beige line), the description states the peak is in 2011. The graph shows the peak of approximately 14.5% occurs in 2012.
For Токуда (beige line), the description claims the value drops to ~10% in 2015. The graph shows the value in 2015 is about 12%.
